subject: error when trying to fit a bifactor model with itemtype=gpcm

messages.author: faac30d61a7928c3
messages.subject: error when trying to fit a bifactor model with itemtype=gpcm
parts:
Hi Phil,

Your package is saving my thesis!
I have to fit a bifactor model, with one general dimension and three specific dimensions. I have 11 variables (integer, 1 to 4) and around 1,380 observations. 
I specified the model as follows:

spec <- "
S = 1-11
N = 1-3
P = 4-7
C = 8-11
START = (1–11, a1, 1.0),(1–3, a2, 1.0),(4–7, a3, 1.0),(7-11, a4, 1.0)
FIXED = (1–11, a1),(1–3, a2),(4–7, a3),(8-11, a4)
FREE = (GROUP, COV_11),(GROUP, COV_22),(GROUP, COV_33), (GROUP, COV_44)" 

But when I try to fit the model:
mod.md.pcm <- mirt(w, model=spec,itemtype="gpcm", 
SE=T, method="MHRM",SE.type = "FMHRM", technical=list(MHRM_SE_draws=10000))

I get this error message:
Error in Fun(X[[i]], ...):
   trying to get slot "par" from an object of a basic class ("NULL") with no slots
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion
2: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion
3: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion

I can't really understand what goes on! Your help would be really precious!
Thanks
